subtopics.objective: Identify the meanings and functions of words, phrases, clauses, sentences, figures of speech and idioms in context.

subtopics.content: (ii)(c) Coherence and logical reasoning, including deductions and inferences

subtopics.objective: Answer questions testing comprehension of a passage.
Synthesize information from a passage and identify its main ideas.

Demonstrate understanding of the prescribed reading text.
Interpret information conveyed in sentences.
Determine opposite meanings of words.

Recognise emphatic stress in connected speech.
The examination consists of 60 questions across Comprehension and Summary, Lexis and Structure, and Oral Forms.
